subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should `heartbeat.session` win over an originating session key for system-event/exec-triggered heartbeat wakes, and should the prior cross-session event migration approach be adopted, replaced, or narrowed?
rationale: The bug is source-backed, but the repair changes session-routing precedence and event ownership across heartbeat, exec, and Telegram-visible delivery, and the existing candidate PR is conflicting and previously flagged as risky/unproven.

options.title: Adopt config-wins heartbeat routing
options.body: Make configured heartbeat session context authoritative for system-event wakes, preserve only the needed wake payloads safely, and add regression tests for the exec-notify path.

options.title: Keep origin-session wake routing
options.body: Document that wake-triggered heartbeats intentionally run in the originating session and close this direction as unsupported, accepting the current pollution risk.

options.title: Defer to per-session heartbeat redesign
options.body: Leave this issue open only as input to the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling work instead of patching the current wake path now.

recommendation.title: Adopt config-wins heartbeat routing
recommendation.body: Make configured heartbeat session context authoritative for system-event wakes, preserve only the needed wake payloads safely, and add regression tests for the exec-notify path.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the heartbeat resolver and system-event code makes this the best available routing owner for deciding the invariant.
